title: Integrate System One Harness patterns as a provider-neutral FA3 reflex runtime
decision: Adopt finite typed action-space compilation, risk-class confidence gating, explicit finish/escalate outcomes and structured handoff inside the existing Decision Fabric. Do not adopt SystemOneHarness as an authority, model router, secret owner, resource broker or direct executor.
invariants: the model may choose only caller-authorized actions and finite parameter values
no direct OpenRouter or TypeSafe call is introduced
no physical model or provider is pinned
no silent local-to-cloud fallback is allowed
reflex runtime never performs tool execution itself
low-confidence and explicit escalation produce a typed handoff
unsupported MCP tools are reported with reason codes and never silently weakened
decision traces retain the model probability distributions required to audit the confidence gate
